description: hatch phase-1 harness enforcement: binder immutability, pack write validation, fail-closed auditor dispatch, fail-closed gate-dispatch diff guard (a gate-reviewer dispatch with an empty diff range or a missing/mismatched Diff-size line is denied before two reviewer contexts spin up), confined-writer surfaces (kaizen and doc-gardner, on Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit and on their Bash commands) and read-only gate reviewers (acceptance, safety, design: every edit tool denied, write-shaped Bash denied — hook enforcement for the recognized command shapes, not a sandbox), session status injection, the delivery Stop-gate (a session may not quietly stop with built-but-unmerged items or a complete-but-unarchived binder — blocked once per state, then the identical stop passes), and the SubagentStop whiff advisory (a hatch-typed subagent stopping while an item branch stands with no commits over integration and no state ref is told once — stateless, loop-guarded by stop_hook_active — to surface the whiff in its report). Same contract everywhere: hook payload JSON on stdin; exit 0 allows, exit 2 blocks (PreToolUse, Stop, SubagentStop) or feeds corrective stderr back to the model (PostToolUse).
